note: Realistic filled-in states in the HSE Workplace Safety Audit engine's shape. Each checklist item grades to compliant (1), minor (2), major (3) or critical (4); the overall outcome is the highest severity fired. Positively-phrased controls (yes/na = compliant, no = finding); negatively-phrased items (no/na = compliant, yes = finding). `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.additionalFlags via flagsHint "detectAdditionalFlags" with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectAdditionalFlags(state); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: compliant
personas.description: Well-run site with every audited control in place: no findings raised — outcome compliant.
